	static long mod = 998244353;

	static long modPow(long a, long e) // O(log e)
	{
		a %= mod;
		long res = 1;
		while (e > 0) {
			if ((e & 1) == 1)
				res = (res * a) % mod;
			a = (a * a) % mod;
			e >>= 1;
		}
		return res;
	}

	static long[] fac, invfac;

	public static long nck(long n, long k) {
		return fac[(int) n] * invfac[(int) k] % mod * invfac[(int) (n - k)] % mod;
	}

		PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
		long n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
		long k = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
		if (k >= n) {
			pw.println(0);
			pw.close();
			return;

		invfac = new long[(int) n + 1];

		long negans = 0;

					numChars = r.read(buf);

					throw new InputMismatchException();
				}
				if (numChars <= 0) {
					return -1;
				}

			return buf[curChar++];
		}

				c = next();
			}

			boolean neg = false;

			while (isSpaceChar(c)) {
				c = next();
			}
			long res = 0;
			boolean neg = false;
			c = next();
			while (c >= 0 && !isSpaceChar(c)) {
				res = res * 10 + c - '0';
				c = next();
			}
			if (c == '-') {
				neg = true;
				c = next();
			}
			res *= (neg) ? -1 : 1;
			return res;
		}

		public String nextLine() {
			int c = next();
			while (isSpaceChar(c)) {
				c = next();
			}

		}
